name: Loop the outro
lesson:
## Buy yourself time

A is near its end. Press IN on the downbeat of bar 9 and OUT on the downbeat of bar 13: a clean 4-bar loop of the outro that will run for as long as you need. Bring B in on bar 17, and exit the loop with RELOOP/EXIT on bar 21 as A fades.

Techno outros are often shorter than the blend you want, and this is the fix Charlotte de Witte describes: loop the last section about 45 seconds before the end so the mix is on your schedule, not the track's. The two loop presses have to land on bar lines; a loop that starts on beat 2 lurches every time it wraps.
